Package com.hiface.sdk.frame

Class Yuv420Frame

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.frame.Yuv420Frame
public final class Yuv420Frame extends java.lang.Object
YUV_420_888 frame descriptor. Retains Buffer references without copying pixels or managing the camera frame lifetime. Keep inputs valid during the call; close or reuse the original frame after processFrame returns. All three planes must be DirectByteBuffer objects. Dimensions must be positive and even, within the long/short-side limits. Rotation must be 0, 90, 180, or 270. Set range and matrix from capture metadata; the SDK does not infer the color space.
